sources_note: Every record below was re-fetched live from the museum API on 2026-11-08 (Met collectionapi v1 objects, AIC api.artic.edu, Cleveland openaccess-api). title_ja_source (checked 2026-11-12 against the museum APIs, the ARC Ukiyo-e Portal via jpsearch/cultural.jp, ukiyo-e.org and ColBase): "recorded" = the title as recorded by a source (title_ja_ref); "descriptive" = no recorded Japanese title, a short description; "unsure" = not settled (see title_ja_note). The Met v1 /search endpoint was retired on 2026-10-01; v1.1/search was used.

eras.notes: Ink-only prints. All picks have AIC/Met medium text saying sumizuri-e or "ink on paper", except 2 flagged. Many AIC Moronobu/Sugimura sheets are erotic-series prints; those were excluded. Several AIC "sumizuri-e" sheets are listed as "hand-colored" (colour added later); those were avoided here so the era reads as pure ink.
